# viettelcloud_volume (Data Source)

Get one Viettel Cloud Block Storage volume by ID or exact filter criteria.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "viettelcloud_volume" "by_id" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
}

data "viettelcloud_volume" "by_name" {
  name = "example-data-volume"
}

data "viettelcloud_volume" "by_name_and_size" {
  name = "example-data-volume"
  size = 30
}

data "viettelcloud_volume" "by_name_and_status" {
  name   = "example-data-volume"
  status = "available"
}

data "viettelcloud_volume" "by_name_and_bootable" {
  name     = "example-data-volume"
  bootable = false
}

data "viettelcloud_volume" "by_name_and_zone" {
  name = "example-data-volume"
  zone = "zone-a"
}

data "viettelcloud_volume" "by_all_filters" {
  id       = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
  name     = "example-data-volume"
  size     = 30
  status   = "available"
  bootable = false
  zone     = "zone-a"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `bootable` (Boolean) Whether to filter for bootable volumes.
- `id` (String) Volume ID (UUID).
- `name` (String) Volume name to filter by.
- `size` (Number) Volume size in GiB to filter by.
- `status` (String) Volume status to filter by.
- `zone` (String) Zone name to filter by.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the volume was created (RFC3339).
- `description` (String) Volume description.
- `encrypted` (Boolean) Whether the volume is encrypted.
- `iops` (Number) Provisioned IOPS.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (UUID) owning the volume.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the volume was last updated (RFC3339).
- `volume_type` (String) Effective volume type name.
- `zone_id` (String) Zone ID (UUID) where the volume resides.
